title: Re-scope TSK-0350: Fix IsLoopback null-IP fail-open across 3 security gates
description:
Re-scope TSK-0350: Fix IsLoopback null-IP fail-open across 3 security gates (Council-refined)

Source: memorysmith-isloopback-audit-26-07-16-20-02-55.md

Problem: `MemorySmithRequestGuardMiddleware.IsLoopback(IPAddress? address)` returns `true` when `address is null`. Three independent security gates inherit this default causing fail-open behavior when `RemoteIpAddress` can be null in production (reverse-proxy misconfigs). Update TSK-0350 scope and raise priority.

Acceptance criteria:
- Change helper to fail-closed for null IP addresses
- Add unit tests for middleware, `BootstrapGate`, and `SecurityServices.IsLoopbackRequest`
- Document forwarded-headers guidance in deployment docs and startup warning

Effort: 2-4h

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Council Note: Rescoping to include null-IPAddress production scenario; raise priority to High. Add unit test asserting null RemoteIpAddress is not treated as loopback for middleware, BootstrapGate, and SecurityServices.IsLoopbackRequest.
